name: Night
role: Co-ruler of the Abyss with Chaos
description: Category C, classical borrowing. In Hesiod's Theogony, Night (Nyx) is one of the first entities born from Chaos, mother of Day and a host of personified abstractions -- further layered in Milton with Orphic cosmogony (Night as formless womb), Ovid, Plato's Timaeus, and Neoplatonism. Not biblical content. See docs/milton/character-catalog.md §III.
narrative_function: Rules the Abyss alongside Chaos; grants Satan passage.
